text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: PD-98765 — inference-eu-embeddings — 5xx rate spike (>10% over 2m). Link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD-98765
maria: ack — jumping in. spinning up logs and checking pool health
maria: `kubectl get pods -n inference-eu` shows multiple infer-worker-* in CrashLoopBackOff and some OOMKilled entries
sam: oncall here. want me to take primary? what’s the customer impact?
maria: yes please hand if you can. Impact: embeddings 5xx for EU customers, throughput down ~30%, several paying customers affected. informing support now.
maria: running `metrics.query("rate(ingress_5xx_total{region=\"eu\"}[2m])")` — spike at 12.4%
jordan: I can grab the logs and ASG status. maria -> handoff to @jordan? :handshake:
maria: handing to @jordan, I'll stay as secondary. tl;dr: kvcache evictions after last deploy, autoscaler at max capacity, some nodes showing memory pressure
jordan: grabbing pod logs — repeated stacktrace: `kv_cache::evict() -> panic: allocation failed` on infer-worker-gpu. ASG for eu-pool at desired=30, max=30
oncall-sre: noted. I've opened a ticket with infra to allow temporary scale-up for eu-pool if needed. Kicking a couple of instance restarts to clear possible host-level memory corruption
jordan: doing a soft restart of 2 nodes in eu-asg to force pod reschedule. enabling fallback route to quantized smaller model to reduce memory per process: `route set inference-eu -> model-embed-small-v2`
sam: @support-team can you post quick customer update: short, non-technical, ETA ~15m for next update?
support-team: Draft sent to #support: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors for embeddings in the EU region. Engineers are actively mitigating. Next update in 15 minutes or sooner."
alerts-bot: Support impacted customers list: cust-alpha, cust-bravo, cust-gamma (high-volume). Notifying account reps
jordan: nodes back up, pods rescheduled. error rate down to ~4.1% and still trending down. observing fewer OOMs in logs
maria: great. keeping @jordan as primary. maria -> backing off to secondary and monitoring error rate and latency charts
jordan: enabling canary fallback routing for 10% of traffic to quantized model to reduce load. will gradually ramp if stable
sam: pinging legal/comms for a customer-facing note if this persists >30m
oncall-sre: infra allowed temporary scale bump; increased eu-asg max to 40 and added capacity headroom
jordan: scaling applied, resource pressure easing. error rate 2.9% now. metrics: `ingress_5xx_rate{region="eu"} = 2.9`
maria: leaving bridge to @jordan for now. please add postmortem label and create ticket for rollback evaluation
jordan: acknowledged in PD and updated incident timeline. preliminary root cause hypothesis: memory leak in kv-cache component introduced in last deployment (rollout id: r-2026-03-11-kv-cache)
support-team: Notifying affected customers with the interim message. will follow up when fully resolved
incident-bot: PD-98765 status update: acknowledged by jordan. current 5xx rate 3.2% (was 12.4%).
jordan: proceeding with controlled rollback of kv-cache patch on one canary node, monitoring for regressions
maria: created INF-4523 for post-incident investigation and rollback plan. adding owners and timeline
alerts-bot: Incident progressed: fallback routing + scale up reduced customer impact. Preparing final customer notification once baseline restored
jordan: rollback successful on canary; no new OOMs observed in last 5m. beginning wider rollback across eu pool
oncall-sre: autoscaler headroom reduced back to normal after rollback completed.
alerts-bot: Incident resolved — 5xx rate back to baseline 0.5%. Customers notified.
maria: thanks all. follow-ups: 1) revert kv-cache change permanently until fix, 2) increase autoscaler headroom for eu_pool, 3) add canary/monitor gate for kv-cache deploys
sam: noted. will prep comms and track INF-4523 actions. :thumbsup:
